row.evidence: Smarsh publishes no pricing and its Enterprise Archive documentation sits behind a Smarsh Central customer login; the only IdP catalogue entry found (Okta's Smarsh Archiving Platform) is a password-vaulting SWA app.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: Smarsh sells its archiving, capture and surveillance products (Enterprise Platform, Professional Archive, Capture Mobile, Digital Safe and others) through sales with no public price list. No public page describes SCIM, SAML SSO or user provisioning; the main admin product documentation (Enterprise Platform) requires a customer login, so absence cannot be confirmed. www.smarsh.com blocks curl and the headless renderer (nginx 403). Okta's OIN lists 'Smarsh Archiving Platform' (last updated 2015) with SWA only; no Microsoft Entra tutorial exists.

okta.notes: OIN 'Smarsh Archiving Platform' marks only SWA as checked (read from page markup); no SAML, OIDC or SCIM.

entra.notes: No Smarsh entry in Microsoft Learn's SaaS app tutorial index.

fallbacks.notes: docs.smarsh.com's public index links to per-product documentation; Enterprise Platform (Enterprise Archive) and Professional Archive docs redirect to a Smarsh Central customer login. Capture Mobile docs are public but cover the messaging app, not identity provisioning.
